snippet.title: 1000 Waves // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312510/1000_Waves/

1000 Waves is a bullet hell arcade game that becomes progressively difficult as you approach the 1000th wave. Strengthen your ship by leveling up and conquer the final boss!

Developed by
Levi Star Grimsley​
